item.title: Pakistan passes bill to form National Commission for Minorities after decade of delay
item.description: Pakistan’s Parliament has passed a long-delayed law establishing a National Commission for Minorities, marking a step toward institutional protection for religious minorities after years of advocacy and judicial pressure, though the move has prompted only cautious optimism. #Pakistan #NationalCommissionforMinorities #ChristiansinPakistan #Ahmadis #Shia #Muslims

item.title: For Tasha Layton 'Life in Me' is a 5 loaves and 2 fish moment
item.description: Being obedient to God is something that all of us ascribe to, but so few of us always follow through. Sometimes the simplest things seem to get in our way. #TashaLayton #CCM #Christianmusic

item.title: Thousands of Christians rally in Delhi against ‘rising, sustained, systematic’ attacks
item.description: Around 2,000 Christians from across India gathered in New Delhi to protest rising, sustained and systematic violence against the religious minority community. Speakers at the gathering called attention to a 500% rise in reported violence since 2014, and largely with impunity. #IndianChristians #ChristianPersecution #HinduNationalism #AntiConversionLaws #AttacksonChristians #Violence #ProtestinIndia

item.title: Churchgoers gift more money, food at Christmastime to help those in need: study
item.description: Christmas has long been a time of giving, and for church-going Protestants, this generally translates into giving more money and food to help those in need, a new study published by Lifeway Research shows. #Protestants #giving #Christmas #churchgoers #church #charity

item.title: Spanberger appoints FBI agent linked to memo on 'radical' Catholics to public safety post
item.description: Virginia Democrat governor-elect Abigail Spanberger has appointed the Federal Bureau of Investigation agent whose office released a memo many considered anti-Catholic to a post in her administration. #AbigailSpanberger #FBI #radicaltraditionalistCatholic #memo #Meador #Democrat #Virginia

item.title: Review: Kevin Costner brings gritty, reverent lens to Nativity in 'The First Christmas'
item.description: “Kevin Costner Presents: The First Christmas” takes a direct and reverent approach to the Nativity story, exchanging the traditional holiday cheer for a more historically grounded portrayal of the circumstances, no matter how difficult, surrounding Jesus’ birth. #KevinCostner #Christmas #KevinCostnerPresentsTheFirstChristmas

item.title: Supreme Court revives Amish challenge to New York student vaccination requirement
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court has revived a lawsuit filed by a group of Amish parents against a New York state law that removes a religious exemption to school immunizations. #SupremeCourt #Amish #vaccine #religiousexemption #schools #students #measles #outbreak

item.title: Nigerian authorities secure release of 100 kidnapped Catholic school children
item.description: One hundred children kidnapped from a Catholic boarding school in central Nigeria last month have been released by their captors and transported to the capital, authorities confirmed Sunday. The fate of more than 160 other students and staff members abducted in the same attack remains unknown. #NigeriaKidnappings #MassAbduction #Hostages #CatholicBoardingSchool #BokoHaram #Fulani #Jihadist #Christians #Genocide

item.title: Pastor Robert Jeffress to testify on how Biden admin. targeted First Baptist Dallas
item.description: Pastor Robert Jeffress of First Baptist Dallas will testify this week about how the church was targeted by the IRS under the Biden administration as the Trump administration continues to take steps to prioritize religious liberty and allow pastors to speak about politics from the pulpit. #RobertJeffress #Religiousliberty #Biden #IRS #DOJ

item.title: Jonathan Evans, son of Tony Evans, installed as new leader of Oak Cliff Bible Fellowship
item.description: Tony Evans' son, Jonathan Evans, was formally installed as the new lead pastor at Oak Cliff Bible Fellowship Church in Dallas, Texas, two months after elders restored their founding Pastor back to ministry following an undisclosed sin. #JonathanEvans #TonyEvans #OakCliffBibleFellowship
